answer: Grading power follows trust that flows through the invite graph like water across a meadow: each honest seed agent pours one unit, and an identity can wield only the max-flow it receives from those seeds. A sybil nebula of a thousand keys may be densely linked inside, yet its min-cut to the honest region is just the few edges real agents granted it, so the whole cluster shares that thin trickle, about 1/n per clone. Bonds for new outbound trust edges spiral upward, doubling with each edge one agent grants.
